name: FISHING_FROM_CAUSEWAY_PROHIBITED_WHITE_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. R6-SA102 900 x 600 (2015, 1:10), R50, 7 / 21 (edge 7 + border 14). Three lines 100 C, baselines 185 / 350 / 515 (85 below): FISHING 415 + 70 + FROM 281 (67/415/70/281/67), CAUSEWAY 568 (166/568/166), PROHIBITED 630 (135/630/135). Sheet note: not regulatory by itself — fishing must be prohibited on the causeway by regulation before the sign is installed.
